# checkmk_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a user by username
data "checkmk_user" "example" {
  username = "admin"
}

output "user_fullname" {
  value = data.checkmk_user.example.fullname
}

output "user_roles" {
  value = data.checkmk_user.example.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The username to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication type (password, automation).
- `contact_groups` (List of String) List of contact groups the user belongs to.
- `disable_login` (Boolean) Whether the user's login is disabled.
- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `fullname` (String) The full name of the user.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the user (same as username).
- `roles` (List of String) List of roles assigned to the user.
